page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.16xlarge is a compute-focused instance within the Enhanced family, designed for high-concurrency and CPU-intensive enterprise workloads. Driven by Intel Xeon 8369B processors clocked at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, the system provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity is configured at 128 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per thread. The processor architecture incorporates 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache, backed by instruction extensions including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and hardware cryptography accelerators like VAES and SHA-NI.

Benchmark evaluations reveal strong parallel compute scalability alongside standard single-threaded output. In multi-threaded execution, the instance achieves top-quartile performance, recorded by a multi-core Geekbench score of 16563.0, a PassMark CPU score of 56038.37, and a stress-ng multi-core measurement of 62179.17. High-density tasks such as software compilation with Clang (40782.0) and ray tracing (58935.0) also perform in the top 25%. In contrast, single-core benchmarks—including a Geekbench single-core score of 1613.0 and stress-ng single-core result of 1852.79—reflect mid-tier single-thread throughput typical of 2.7 GHz base clock configurations.

Storage and network architectures require architectural planning. The ecs.c7t.16xlarge includes no bundled local NVMe storage, meaning all persistent data and operating volumes must rely on network-attached block storage. This is balanced by a strong 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating heavy inter-node traffic and remote storage I/O. Memory throughput registers in the average bracket, delivering 169.29 GB/sec on large uncached block reads and 67.55 GB/sec on uncached writes.

Resource allocation renders this instance cost-effective for multi-threaded, parallelized operations where compute utilization outweighs memory footprints. It fits distributed batch processing, continuous integration build farms, multi-threaded compression pipelines, parallel database computing, and lightweight CPU-based machine learning inference workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by 64 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 128 GB of RAM, it maintains a strict 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio tailored for CPU-intensive computing. The instance lacks bundled local storage, requiring external cloud block volumes, but provides a 32 Gbps baseline network interface to sustain high network throughput. In benchmark testing, the ecs.c7t.16xlarge delivers strong multi-core compute metrics across stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark tests, alongside strong performance in Clang software compilation and cryptographic execution. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth tests place in the middle 50% tier. With vector extension support including AVX-512 and VNNI, this instance is suited for multi-threaded build systems, media encoding, distributed data processing, and large-scale web microservices.
